# Roads Audio

> Roads Audio is a voice messaging app for iPhone and Android built around collaborative voice memos. Friends and family share recordings in private, invite-only channels, listen on their own time, and reply to specific moments in a recording, so conversations keep their context.

Key facts:

- Roads is asynchronous. Nobody needs to be online at the same time.
- A Voice Thread is an ongoing audio conversation: one person starts with a recording and others add replies over time.
- Replies can be attached to an exact moment in a recording.
- Channels are private. Only invited members can hear the recordings.
- There is no time limit on recordings. Users can delete anything they've made, but editing isn't available yet.
- Roads works with VoiceOver on iPhone and TalkBack on Android. It is shaped by direct feedback from blind and visually impaired users.

Pricing (USD):

- All core features are free.
- Roads Audio Plus adds premium tools and is available as:
  - Monthly: $4.99 per month, with a 3-day free trial
  - Yearly: $39.99 per year
  - Lifetime: $99.99 one-time purchase
- Prices are in US dollars. The App Store and Google Play show the local price in other regions.
